source: captured against the installed codex-cli 0.154.0 app-server; ids and timestamps are placeholders

turn_start.start_or_steer: turn/start internally calls start_or_steer_turn: when another turn is already active on the thread, turn/start returns the SAME active turn id instead of creating a new turn

concurrent_submission_race.scenario: turn/start issued while a turn was already in progress on the same thread
concurrent_submission_race.interpretation: a simultaneous native-UI submission causes Codex to absorb the Theater message into the already-active turn; Theater must record the returned turn id and must never fabricate a second job or turn
concurrent_submission_race.turn_completed_id: identical to the pre-existing active turn id

turn_steer.completion_turn_id: identical to the steered active turn id; no replacement job/turn is created

stale_turn_refusal.request_context: turn/steer with an expectedTurnId whose turn already completed
stale_turn_refusal.semantics: a refusal; it is never reinterpreted as a new send or a queued message
